sloka: ताभ्यां तौ धनुषि श्रेष्ठे संहितौ सायकोत्तमौ।विकृष्यमाणौ वीराभ्यां भृशं जज्वलतुः श्रिया ।। ६.९१.५० ।।
transliteration: tābhyāṁ tau dhanuṣi śreṣṭhe saṁhitau sāyakottamau।vikṛṣyamāṇau vīrābhyāṁ bhṛśaṁ jajvalatuḥ śriyā ।। 6.91.50 ।।

translations.english: Excellent bows of the two made noise like Krauncha birds while being drawn with great strength by the two, whose arms resembled iron bars.
